summary.text: Yury Polozov is a Republican state representative from Merrimack District 10 who has served since December 7, 2022, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, after advancing from the September 8, 2026 primary. Ballotpedia lists his career experience as senior threat intelligence analyst.

paragraphs.text: Polozov was born in Russia and lives in Hooksett, New Hampshire, according to Ballotpedia.
He earned an M.S. in biology from Saint Petersburg State University in Russia.
His career experience includes working as a senior threat intelligence analyst, and he is a member of the Merrimack County Delegation.
